subject: PO assignment for StratusGrid pilot — onboarding form & line edits
messages:
From: Elena Morales <emorales@stratusgrid.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting PO assignment for StratusGrid pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. We’re ready to kick off the 6-week pilot for the StratusGrid <> Redwood integration. To move forward we need a purchase order on file and a short onboarding packet filled in for vendor setup (legal has the SOW).

Key ask: can you confirm a PO number and a temporary spend cap for the pilot? The pilot includes two SKUs (SG-CE-100, SG-SUP-1) and an optional expansion line if we scale to 3x usage. We’re aiming for an initial spend cap of $25,000 (pilot budget).

I’ve attached our onboarding form and the initial invoice estimate. If you need any corrected line items, I can return an updated CSV.

Attachments: stratusgrid_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), initial_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Cheers,
Elena Morales
Vendor Ops | StratusGrid, Inc.
emorales@stratusgrid.io
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <emorales@stratusgrid.io>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:03:44 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Requesting PO assignment for StratusGrid pilot

Forwarding vendor request — please see Elena’s form attached. Procurement: we need a provisional PO and spend cap for this pilot, plus normalization of the two SKUs into our catalog (they've labelled SG-CE-100 and SG-SUP-1).

Notes / asks: 1) Can we issue a provisional PO number that includes an option line for expansion? 2) Set spend cap to $25,000 initially but allow a single mid-pilot increase by approval. 3) Normalize line items so billing maps to internal product codes (billing will rely on SKU -> GL mapping).

Elena is copied for any clarifying questions. I’d like to close PO issuance this week if possible.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Program Manager, Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Requesting PO assignment for StratusGrid pilot

Thanks for the ping — looping in procurement workflow. Quick clarifying questions before I create the PO:

- Is the $25,000 firm for the whole pilot (inclusive of estimated overage)? If vendor expects a top-up path, we should put an "expansion option" line but leave it unallocated until approved.
- Can we get the vendor to supply a CSV with three columns: vendor_sku, vendor_description, vendor_unit_price? That will make normalization straightforward.
- Who is our billing contact for invoicing frequency (monthly / milestone)?

Proposed temporary approach: I can provision a pilot PO (PO template: "PROV-2027-XXXX") for $25k, include an option line for expansion (not funded) and set an alert at 80% utilization. If that works we’ll generate the provisional PO and return it for vendor signature.

I attached the PO template I’ll use (internal) and will create the PO once the CSV is received.

Attachments referenced: po_template_provisional.pdf

Monica
Monica Patel
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <emorales@stratusgrid.io>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stratusgrid.io
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Requesting PO assignment for StratusGrid pilot

Hi Monica / Olga — thanks for the quick follow-up.

Confirmed: $25,000 is the pilot cap. We are fine with an unallocated option line for expansion, and monthly invoicing is preferred. I’ve attached a cleaned CSV with the three columns you requested (vendor_sku, vendor_description, vendor_unit_price) and a short note on the expansion clause.

Attachments: stratus_line_items_v2.csv (csv)

On the SKU normalization, map SG-CE-100 -> RED-CE-PILOT and SG-SUP-1 -> RED-SUP-1 and add an "expansion" code RED-EXP-OPT (no budget).

Happy to sign the provisional PO once issued.

Best,
Elena

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <emorales@stratusgrid.io>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: PO issued: P-2027-4392 (StratusGrid pilot, spend cap $25,000)

Team — issuing final update. I created and issued the provisional PO: P-2027-4392. Summary:

- PO number: P-2027-4392
- Spend cap (authorized): $25,000
- Line items normalized: RED-CE-PILOT (maps SG-CE-100), RED-SUP-1 (maps SG-SUP-1), RED-EXP-OPT (expansion option, not funded)
- Billing cadence: monthly (vendor requested)
- Alerts: 80% utilization alert configured; manual approval required for any top-up

Attached the issued PO (P-2027-4392-po.pdf). Elena — please countersign and return.

Related links: HubSpot deal PROJ-8741 (https://hubspot.example.com/contacts/PROJ-8741).

If procurement or legal wants different language on the expansion clause, let me know and we can reissue a corrected PO.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
